strongest_bounded_proposition: Multiple Portuguese colonial settings had slavery/slave-trade institutions, but the aggregate sampled label 'Portuguese Colonies' cannot support one territorial-practice state at 1800.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not collapse Goa, African, Atlantic, Timorese or other Portuguese territories into one prevalence/practice condition.
territorial_practice_summary: Slavery documented in multiple Portuguese imperial locations; one aggregate territorial-practice row is invalid.
external_network_summary: Imperial slave-trade participation remains separate from each colony's practice.
terminology_category_qualification: The target is a dispersed imperial grouping, not one society.
temporal_scope_precision: Bounded to cited evidence; sample interval is not itself slavery evidence.
inference_extent: No single territorial-practice inference across aggregate label.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible packet only; non-English/non-digitized scholarship not exhaustively searched.

sources.title: The Cambridge World History of Slavery, Volume 3

unresolved_issues: Aggregate target must be decomposed for substantive territorial research.
